verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe's first-party docs describe custom vocabulary for names, acronyms, technical terms and product names. The vocabulary can be passed inline, saved as reusable Vocabulary Assets managed through list and delete endpoints, and replaced mid-session in Live mode via session.update. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that boosting improves accuracy, and documentation of boost weighting, list size limits, or per-model support.
